change: Prompt v2 renders required source/target affordance tags directly from the frozen relation schema, explicitly directs unsupported distractor relations to NONE/RELATED_TO, and tightens selected-history source guidance. Validator now requires a history source for source-tagged relations.
interpretation: Protocol robustness iteration after prompt-v1 evaluation; both versions will be reported, and v1 results remain preserved.

reason: Added a stronger ambiguity instruction after train/dev diagnosis and manual label audit. Initial 27 train points showed over-abstention, so this prompt was not used for held-out calls.

Train-only partial showed the v3 wording treated broadly plausible future steps as immediate ambiguity. Revised to require multiple comparably plausible immediate next steps with no task/history cue, while allowing informative when one candidate has a clear task-consistent advantage.
heldOutExposureNote: Prompt-v2 on predecessor benchmark was previously observed; v4 result is still an iterative exploratory assessment.
